description: Enriches accepted trades with reference data

responsibility: Loads reporting records into the reporting database
description: Loads reporting records into the reporting database

name: Regulatory Reporting
responsibility: Produces daily reports of money at risk
description: Produces daily reports of money at risk

name: Notification
description: Sends processing and report notifications

name: Submit trade
description: Accept one new financial transaction for processing.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Idempotent by tradeId. A repeated identifier must not create a second transaction.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

requestFields.name: productType
requestFields.constraints: FX_FORWARD exchanges currencies on a future date. FX_SPOT settles promptly.

requestFields.name: notional
requestFields.description: Transaction amount in the base currency.

requestFields.name: counterpartyId
requestFields.description: Identifier of the other trading party.

responseFields.name: evidenceId
responseFields.description: Identifier for the recorded acceptance event.

name: Amend trade
description: Replace the current version of one transaction.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Idempotent for the same tradeId and version.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

requestFields.name: version
requestFields.description: Current version used for concurrency control.

name: Get trade status
description: Return the current processing state of one transaction.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: status
responseFields.constraints: Allowed values: accepted, rejected, enriched, posted.

responseFields.name: updatedAt
responseFields.description: Time of the latest state change.

name: Validate trade
description: Check one transaction against business and compliance rules.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Not guaranteed. Use the documented business identifier to prevent duplicates.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

requestFields.name: legalEntityId
requestFields.description: Legal Entity Identifier of the trading party.

requestFields.name: productType
requestFields.constraints: FX_FORWARD exchanges currencies on a future date. FX_SPOT settles promptly.

responseFields.name: errors
responseFields.description: Validation errors. The array is empty when valid is true.

responseFields.name: ruleSetVersion
responseFields.description: Version of the applied validation rules.

name: Get instrument
description: Return the controlled data for one financial product.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

name: Get exchange rate
description: Return the exchange rate for one currency pair and date.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: rate
responseFields.description: Units of quote currency for one base-currency unit.

responseFields.name: effectiveDate
responseFields.description: Date on which the rate applies.

name: Get counterparty
description: Return the controlled data for one trading party.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

name: Post journal
description: Create balanced accounting entries for one transaction.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Idempotent by tradeId. One transaction can create one active journal.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

requestFields.name: lines
requestFields.constraints: At least two lines. Total debit must equal total credit.

name: Get journal
description: Return accounting entries for one transaction.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

name: Run warehouse load
description: Start one reporting-database load.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: One active run is allowed for each businessDate and mode.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: queuedAt
responseFields.description: Time at which the run entered the queue.

name: Get load status
description: Return the state of one reporting-database load.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: status
responseFields.constraints: Allowed values: queued, running, completed, failed.

name: Get exposure report
description: Return the report of money at risk for one date.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

requestFields.name: counterpartyId
requestFields.description: Limit the report to one trading party.

responseFields.name: positions
responseFields.description: Exposure rows by trading party and product.

name: Generate report
description: Start one exposure-report run.
auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: One report run is allowed for each reportDate and format.

errorResponses.when: A field is missing or has an invalid value.
The service identity is missing or invalid.
The component cannot complete the request.

responseFields.name: outputUri
responseFields.description: Location of the output after completion.

auth: Mutual TLS. Each calling service must prove its identity.
idempotency: Not guaranteed. The caller must prevent duplicate messages.

requestFields.name: variables
requestFields.description: Values used by the message template.

name: Trade Operations DB
description: Operational trade capture and validation state

name: Reference Data DB
description: Controlled instruments, counterparties and rates

name: Ledger DB
description: Balanced accounting journals

name: Reporting Warehouse
description: Reporting data organised by transaction, trading party, and financial product

name: trade
description: Stores the current state of each accepted transaction
grain: One row for the current version of each transaction.
updatePattern: Insert on acceptance. Update on amendment or state change.

name: trade_event
description: Stores a permanent record of each transaction state change

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.description: Stores the time of the event.

grain: One row for each transaction state change.

relationships.description: Each event belongs to one transaction.

name: validation_error
description: Stores the current validation errors for each transaction

columns.name: field
columns.description: Identifies the input field that failed.

columns.name: message
columns.example: Legal Entity Identifier must contain 20 characters.

grain: One row for each active validation error.
updatePattern: Replace errors when validation runs again.

relationships.description: Each error belongs to one transaction.

name: validation_error_legacy
description: Stores validation errors from the retired validator

columns.name: legacy_code
columns.description: Stores the code used by the retired validator.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Stores the time when the row was created.

grain: One row for each archived legacy error.
retention: Until the archive owner approves removal.

relationships.cardinality: Many archived errors to one transaction
relationships.description: The catalogue records the logical link. It does not record a database constraint.

name: instrument
description: Stores the controlled definition of each financial product
grain: One row for each financial product.
updatePattern: Update when controlled reference data changes.
retention: Current row plus 7 years of audit history.

name: counterparty
description: Stores the approved identity of each trading party

columns.name: lei
columns.description: Stores the registered Legal Entity Identifier.

grain: One row for each approved trading party.
updatePattern: Update when controlled reference data changes.
retention: Current row plus 7 years of audit history.

name: exchange_rate
description: Stores one daily conversion rate for each currency pair

columns.name: currency_pair
columns.description: Identifies the base and quote currencies.

columns.name: rate
columns.description: Stores units of quote currency for one base-currency unit.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: Stores the date on which the rate applies.

grain: One row for each currency pair and effective date.

name: journal_entry
description: Stores one accounting journal for each processed transaction
grain: One row for each accounting journal.
updatePattern: Insert when Ledger Posting accepts a journal.

name: journal_line
description: Stores the debit and credit lines of each journal

columns.name: debit
columns.description: Stores the debit amount. Zero means that the line is not a debit.

columns.name: credit
columns.description: Stores the credit amount. Zero means that the line is not a credit.

grain: One row for each debit or credit line.
updatePattern: Insert with its journal. Do not update after posting.

relationships.description: Each line belongs to one journal.

name: fact_trade
description: Stores accepted transactions in the reporting format

columns.name: trade_key
columns.description: Warehouse key for one accepted transaction.

columns.name: amount_base
columns.description: Stores the transaction amount in the reporting currency.

grain: One row for each accepted transaction and report date.
updatePattern: Load during the daily warehouse run.

relationships.cardinality: Many facts to one trading party
relationships.description: The key identifies the reporting version of the trading party.

name: fact_exposure
description: Stores the amount of money at risk for each trading party and report date

columns.name: report_date
columns.description: Stores the date of the exposure report.

columns.name: net_exposure
columns.description: Stores the money at risk after offsetting eligible amounts.

grain: One row for each report date and trading party.
updatePattern: Rebuild during the daily warehouse run.

relationships.cardinality: Many exposure rows to one trading party
relationships.description: The key identifies the reporting version of the trading party.

name: dim_counterparty
description: Stores reporting versions of each trading party

columns.name: lei
columns.description: Stores the registered Legal Entity Identifier.

columns.name: valid_from
columns.description: Stores the time from which the dimension row is valid.

grain: One row for each reporting version of a trading party.
updatePattern: Insert a new row when controlled data changes.
retention: 10 years after the last valid date.

name: dim_instrument
description: Stores reporting versions of each financial product

columns.name: instrument_key
columns.description: Warehouse key for one financial product.

grain: One row for each reporting version of a financial product.
updatePattern: Insert a new row when controlled data changes.
retention: 10 years after the last valid date.

name: load_audit
description: Stores the result and row count of each warehouse load

columns.name: row_count
columns.description: Stores the number of committed rows.

columns.name: completed_at
columns.description: Stores the completion time. The value is null while the load runs.

grain: One row for each warehouse load.
updatePattern: Insert at start. Update at completion or failure.

name: reporting.cutoff-time
description: Daily report completion target

name: reporting.batch-size
description: Warehouse load batch size

name: reference-data.provider
description: Reference-data provider selection

name: trade-validation.strict-lei
description: Strict LEI validation

name: etl.retry-count
description: Warehouse load retry limit

name: etl.warehouse-schema
description: Target warehouse schema

name: notifications.enabled
description: Notification delivery switch

name: journal-posting.mode
description: Journal posting mode

name: trade-event.retention-days
description: Trade event retention

name: reporting.output-format
description: Regulatory report output format

description: Feature toggle controlling new netting model.

name: legacy-netting-mode
description: Feature toggle controlling legacy netting mode.

name: synthetic-reference-data
description: Feature toggle controlling synthetic reference data.

name: strict-lei-validation
description: Feature toggle controlling strict lei validation.

name: exposure-report-v2
description: Feature toggle controlling exposure report v2.

name: fast-reconciliation
description: Feature toggle controlling fast reconciliation.
